# Implementation plan: Crew Chatter MVP

## Approach

The backend is an Express 4 + TypeScript (ESM) API mounted under `/api`. It uses PostgreSQL through `pg`. At startup it creates the schema idempotently from `backend/src/lib/schema.ts`. Sessions are opaque random tokens. Each token is stored as a hash in a `sessions` table and sent to the browser in an httpOnly `cc_session` cookie, so sign-out and password reset can revoke sessions on the server. Every query on user data filters by `user_id`, either directly or through the owning note. A resource the caller does not own is reported as 404, exactly as if it did not exist.

The frontend keeps the existing Vite dev proxy for `/api`. That keeps requests same-origin, so the browser sends the cookie without extra CORS setup. TanStack Query holds server state and Zustand holds session and navigation state. There is no router: the store switches views.

Note bodies are stored as TipTap JSON (`notes.body jsonb`). The server derives a plain-text column (`notes.body_text`) that feeds previews, search and exports. Checklist items live in `checklist_items` and are synced from the task-item nodes in the body. Those nodes carry stable ids.

Every list and filter follows one visibility rule:

- Trashed notes appear only in the Trash view.
- The dashboard and folder note lists show active notes by default. The Archive view shows archived notes.
- The Pinned, tag and Open tasks views show active and archived notes by default. Each criterion for those views asks for exactly the matching notes that are not in the trash.
- In every list view, the archive-state filter (Active, Archived or All) can override the default.

## Decisions on open questions

Each decision below is a plan assumption. Each one sits behind a configuration value or a single function, so it can change without rework.

- OD-001: A reset token is 32 random bytes, encoded as base64url and stored as a SHA-256 hash. It is single-use and valid for `PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES` (default 30). The repository has no mail dependency, so one function, `deliverResetLink`, writes the link `${APP_URL}/?resetToken=...` to the server log. A mailer can replace that function later. No API response ever contains the token.
- OD-002: One server-wide setting, `TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 30).
- OD-003: The size limit is `ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES` (default 25 MB). Supported types are PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP (these get inline previews), PDF, plain text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, ZIP, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX. SVG and HTML are rejected because they can carry script.
- OD-004: Creating a note creates version 1. A change to the title or body creates a new version if the newest version is older than `VERSION_INTERVAL_MINUTES` (default 5); otherwise it updates the newest version in place. Restoring a version always creates a new version.
- OD-005: Every version is kept. The OD-004 interval limits how many versions an editing session creates, and keeping all of them means a restore never removes an earlier version.
- OD-006: Import accepts one or more `.md` or `.txt` files; the repository has no unzip library. In Markdown front matter, `folder: A/B` creates any missing folders along the path and `tags: [x, y]` creates any missing tags. Existing folders (same exact name under the same parent) and tags (same name ignoring case) are reused and not counted. Within one batch, each new folder path and each new tag is counted and created once. MD and TXT files carry no binary files, so the attachment count is always 0 and image references stay as links.
- OD-007: The full export includes active and archived notes and leaves out trashed notes.
- OD-008: The new-note shortcut is Alt+N (Option+N on macOS), matched with `event.code === 'KeyN'` while Ctrl, Meta and Shift are not pressed and no IME composition is active. AltGr reports Ctrl+Alt on Windows, so it never triggers the shortcut. Users cannot change it. Ctrl/Cmd+N is reserved by browsers.
- OD-009: Results are ordered by `ts_rank` of a prefix `tsquery` built from the query terms (descending), then by `updated_at` descending.
- OD-010: By default, search covers active and archived notes. The status filter offers All, Active and Archived. Trashed notes are never searched.
- OD-011: Date-range filters apply to `updated_at`.
- OD-012: This delivery adds no performance test harness. The GIN full-text index, trigram indexes and composite list indexes are aimed at the response-time targets.
- OD-013: The layout switches at the Tailwind `md` breakpoint (768 px). Narrower viewports get the mobile drawer layout.
- OD-014: When a folder is deleted, its subfolders move up to the deleted folder's parent and keep their notes. Only notes directly inside the deleted folder follow the user's choice.
- OD-015: Opening a search result opens the note without scrolling to the match.
- OD-016 and OD-017: Body text uses Tailwind gray-700 or darker on white, aiming at WCAG 2.1 AA. There is no browser-specific code.
- OD-018, OD-019 and OD-021: These are deployment and operations concerns outside this delivery. The session cookie is `Secure` when `NODE_ENV=production`.
- OD-020: Export downloads expire after `EXPORT_TTL_HOURS` (default 24) and the cleanup sweep removes them.
- OD-022: Attachments and export ZIPs live in a private directory, `UPLOAD_DIR`, which defaults to `~/.crew-chatter/storage` outside the repository. The server never serves this directory directly; every read goes through a route that checks the session and ownership.
- OD-023: Only the full-collection export asks for confirmation.
- OD-024: Pressing Escape in the editor saves any pending edit and returns focus to the note's item in the note list.

## Constraints for passing the verification commands

- The backend is ESM (`type: module`, `module: ES2020`, `moduleResolution: bundler`). Relative imports need a `.js` suffix (for example `./lib/db.js`) so that `node dist/index.js` can resolve them.
  - Import `pg` as a default import (`import pg from 'pg'`).
  - Import `bcryptjs`, `multer` and `pdfkit` as default imports.
  - Import `{ ZipArchive }` from `archiver`. Version 8 has no default export; create archives with `new ZipArchive({ zlib: { level: 9 } })`.
  - Use `randomUUID` and `createHash` from `node:crypto`, not the `uuid` package.
- The backend emits declarations (`declaration: true`). Annotate exported values whose types come from libraries so tsc never needs to name an unreachable type (TS2742): `export const noteRouter: Router = Router()`, `export function createApp(): Express`, and explicit return types on exported service functions.
- Both workspaces compile against `lib: ES2020`. Do not use `String.prototype.replaceAll`, `Array.prototype.at` or `Object.hasOwn`.
- ESLint runs `eslint:recommended` plus `@typescript-eslint/recommended` (v8):
  - No `any`; use `unknown` and narrow it.
  - No namespaces. Do not augment `Express.Request`; store the user id in `res.locals` and read it through a typed helper.
  - No unused variables, including unused `catch` bindings. Use `catch {` with a comment in the block, because empty blocks fail `no-empty`.
  - No bare expression statements such as `cond && fn()` (`no-unused-expressions`).
  - No control characters in regex literals (`no-control-regex`). Sanitize file names by filtering on `charCodeAt` instead.
  - No needless escapes in regexes (`no-useless-escape`). Wrap lexical declarations inside `case` clauses in braces (`no-case-declarations`). Use `const` wherever a variable is never reassigned (`prefer-const`).
  - Do not declare unused trailing parameters.
  - The Express error handler must use its `next` parameter: call `next(err)` when headers have already been sent.
- The frontend `tsc` is strict, with `noUnusedLocals` and `noUnusedParameters`. The `vite/client` types are not referenced, so do not read `import.meta.env`; call the API through relative `/api` paths. `frontend/src/main.tsx` imports the default export of `./App.tsx`, so that export stays.
- TipTap packages:
  - `@tiptap/starter-kit` pulls in its own nested copies of `@tiptap/core`, `@tiptap/pm` and `@tiptap/extension-list`, as recorded in `package-lock.json`. `@tiptap/extension-list` cannot be imported from `frontend/`.
  - Build the checklist nodes with `Node.create`, `ReactNodeViewRenderer`, `NodeViewWrapper` and `NodeViewContent` from `@tiptap/react`, which re-exports `@tiptap/core`.
  - Import `Plugin` from `@tiptap/pm/state`. It is installed in `frontend/node_modules` as a peer of `@tiptap/react`, and the root holds a single `prosemirror-state`.
  - If TypeScript rejects mixing the two core copies in one extensions array, type that array once as `Extensions` with `as unknown as Extensions` in `NoteEditor.tsx`.
- Generate client-side ids with `v4` from `uuid` (a declared frontend dependency that ships its own types). `crypto.randomUUID` only exists on secure origins.
- Slice user text by code point (`Array.from`) or with Postgres `left()`, never by UTF-16 index, so emoji are never split.
- No file outside the approved scope changes. That rules out new dependencies and edits to `package.json`, lockfiles, config files, `index.css` and `.gitignore`.

## Tasks
